home.title: Frezowane ogrzewanie podłogowe bez skuwania
home.lead: Frezujemy wylewkę pod ogrzewanie podłogowe i układamy rury w podłodze, którą już masz. 50 m² kończymy w jeden dzień, a kurz od razu trafia do odkurzacza.
home.description: Ogrzewanie podłogowe frezowane w wylewce, którą już masz. 50 m² w jeden dzień, bez kurzu. 5,0 w Google, 70+ opinii. Cała Polska.
home.heading: Ciepła podłoga bez skuwania posadzki.
home.aboutBody: Jesteśmy z Małopolski i od 6 lat jeździmy do klientów po całej Polsce. Robimy podłogówkę w starych domach, w mieszkaniach w blokach i na nowych budowach. Frezujemy z odkurzaczem przemysłowym, więc w czasie pracy możesz normalnie mieszkać w domu.

cookies.title: This site uses cookies
cookies.message: We use cookies so the site works correctly and so we know what to improve. Details are in our
cookies.dialogDescription: Decide which categories to enable. You can change this at any time.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Keep your session alive, protect forms and remember this very cookie decision. The site will not work without them, so they cannot be turned off.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Show us which pages get visited and where visitors get lost. The data is aggregated — it is not used to identify an individual.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Let us measure how well ads perform and show them to people who visited the site. These are behind the ads that appear to follow you around.

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.description: Remember choices such as language or light/dark theme, so you do not have to set them on every visit.

cookies.decisionRequired: To use this site choose “Accept” or open “Settings”.
cookies.lockedSwitch: This category is required and cannot be turned off.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Plain language wherever possible. What data we collect, why, and how you can take it back.

administrator.title: Who processes your data
administrator.body: The data controller is the company that comes to you with the milling machine. If you have a question about your data, you write or call us — not a legal department.

data.title: What data we collect
data.body: Only what you enter in the quote form and what the cookies you accept collect.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.purpose: To call you back with a quote.

area.label: Floor area and town
area.purpose: To work out the price and plan the trip.

technical.label: Technical data
technical.purpose: IP address, browser, pages visited — only after you accept analytics cookies.

purposes.title: Why and on what legal basis
purposes.body: Preparing a quote and booking a date are steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We keep invoices and accounts because tax law requires it (point c). Site statistics and advertising run only with your consent (point a), which you can withdraw at any time.

retention.title: How long
retention.body: Enquiries that led nowhere are deleted after 12 months. Accounting records are kept for 5 years from the end of the tax year. Cookie data — until you withdraw consent, no longer than 13 months.

recipients.title: Who we share it with
recipients.body: We do not sell data. Access is limited to companies that help us run the site and the office: hosting (Vercel), email (Google), our accounting office and — with your consent — analytics and advertising providers (Google, Meta).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We group them into four categories. Necessary cookies always work; the others only once you switch them on. You can change your decision at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to access, correct, delete, restrict or port your data, and object to its processing. Just email {email} — we reply within 30 days. If you believe we break the law, you can complain to the Polish Data Protection Authority (UODO, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw).

validation.email: Enter a valid email address, for example jan@example.com.
validation.phone: Enter a phone number — digits, spaces and dashes.
validation.messageTooShort: Write at least ten characters — a shorter message tells us very little.
validation.consent: Without consent to process your data we cannot reply.
validation.area: Podaj metraż w m², na przykład 80.

service.title: Frezowanie pod ogrzewanie podłogowe: cena, przebieg
service.description: Frezowanie wylewki pod ogrzewanie podłogowe bez skuwania. Sprawdź, od czego zależy cena za m², i zamów darmową wycenę.
service.heading: Frezowanie pod ogrzewanie podłogowe.
service.lead: Masz już wylewkę i chcesz podłogówkę? Nie musisz jej skuwać. Ogrzewanie podłogowe w istniejącej wylewce: wyfrezujemy w niej rowki, ułożymy rury i zalejemy je, a podłoga nie podniesie się nawet o centymetr.
service.howTitle: Zamiast skuwać podłogę, wycinamy w niej rowki pod rurki.
service.howBody: Frezowanie wylewki robimy maszyną z podłączonym odkurzaczem przemysłowym. Frezarka wycina w posadzce rowki na grubość rury, a pył od razu trafia do worka. Dlatego klienci w opiniach najczęściej piszą o jednym: zero kurzu.
service.howPhotoAlt: Frezarka podłączona do odkurzacza przemysłowego w garderobie w trakcie frezowania
service.fitTitle: Czy u mnie się da? Najczęściej tak.
service.fitNote: Nie wiesz, jaką masz wylewkę? Wyślij zdjęcie SMS-em na {phone}, ocenimy za darmo.
